private void btnStartPause_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

{

    if (btnStartPause.Text == "Start Game" )

    {

        btnStartPause.Text = "Pause Game" ;

        btnExitStop.Text = "Stop Game" ;

        LocateVehicle();

 

        for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfVehicles; i++)

            vehicleArr[i].Draw(roadGraphics);

 

        // Removes cars for Level 1

        vehicleArr[0].Remove(roadGraphics,

            new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

        vehicleArr[3].Remove(roadGraphics,

            new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

        vehicleArr[4].Remove(roadGraphics,

            new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

        vehicleArr[6].Remove(roadGraphics,

            new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

        vehicleArr[10].Remove(roadGraphics,

            new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

 

        pnlRoad.Refresh();

 

        LocateBoat();

        for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

            boatArr[i].Draw(riverGraphics);

        pnlRiver.Refresh();

 

        level = 1;

        this .Text = "Jumper - Level 1" ;

        remJumper = 4;

        for ( int i = 0; i < remJumper; i++)

            formGraphics.DrawImage(jumperUp,

                new Rectangle( this .Width - (i + 1) *

                jumperUp.Width - 10, 5, jumperUp.Width,

                jumperUp.Height));

        this .Refresh();

 

        DrawHouse()

        getNewJumper();

 

        timRoad.Enabled = true ;

        timRiver.Enabled = true ;

        timTiger.Enabled = true ;

        timStatus.Enabled = true ;

    }

    else if (btnStartPause.Text == "Pause Game" )

    {

        btnStartPause.Text = "Start Again" ;

        btnExitStop.Enabled = false ;

        timRoad.Enabled = false ;

        timRiver.Enabled = false ;

        timTiger.Enabled = false ;

        timStatus.Enabled = false ;

    }

    else if (btnStartPause.Text == "Start Again" )

    {

        btnStartPause.Text = "Pause Game" ;

        btnExitStop.Enabled = true ;

        timRoad.Enabled = true ;

        timRiver.Enabled = true ;

        timTiger.Enabled = true ;

        timStatus.Enabled = true ;

    }

    pnlStart.Focus();

}

private void JumperNoMore()

    }

 

    else if (jumperLocation == 4)

    else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6

       || jumperLocation == 7)

    {

    else if (jumperLocation == 8)

    {

        soundDrowned.Play();

    }

 

    RemoveJumper();

 

    formGraphics.FillRectangle( new SolidBrush( this .BackColor),

        new Rectangle( this .Width - remJumper * jumperUp.Width - 10 ,

        5, jumperUp.Width, jumperUp.Height));

    this .Refresh();

 

    if (remJumper >= 0)

        getNewJumper();

    else

        btnExitStop.PerformClick();

}

private void timStatus_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

{

    // Check collision

    if (jumperLocation == 1 || jumperLocation == 2

        || jumperLocation == 3)

    {

        // Vehicles

        for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfVehicles; i++)

        {

            if (vehicleArr[i].IsVisible)

            {

                if (DoesCollide(vehicleArr[i].Rectangular,

                    jumper.Rectangular, 10))

                {

                    JumperNoMore();

                    return ;

                }

            }

        }

    }

 

    else if (jumperLocation == 4)

    {

        // tiger

        if (tiger.IsVisible)

        {

            if (DoesCollide( tiger. Rectangular , jumper.Rectangular , 1))

            {

                JumperNoMore();

                return ;

            }

        }

    }

 

    else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

        jumperLocation == 7)

    {

        // Checks whether jumper is on the boat

        if (onBoat == -1)

        {

            for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

            {

                if (boatArr[i].IsVisible)

                {

                    if (DoesCollide(boatArr[i].Rectangular,

                        jumper.Rectangular, 80))

                    {

                        onBoat = i;

                        return ;

                    }

                }

            }

 

            if (onBoat == -1)

            {

                JumperNoMore();

                return ;

            }

        }

    }

 

    else if (jumperLocation == 8)

    {

        // Move to house

        for ( int i = 0; i < 5; i++)

        {

            if (!jumperInHouseArr[i] &&

                DoesCollide(rectHouse[i],

                jumper.Rectangular, 100))

            {

                jumperInHouseArr[i] = true ;

                houseGraphics.DrawImage(jumperInHouse,

                    rectHouse[i].X + 10, rectHouse[i].Y + 10,

                    jumperInHouse.Width, jumperInHouse.Height);

                pnlHouse.Refresh();

                soundHouse.PlaySync();

                getNewJumper();

 

                 // Check for collision

                for ( int j = 0; j < 5; j++)

                    if (!jumperInHouseArr[j])

                        return ;

 

                DrawHouse()

                GoToNextLevel();                

                return ;

            }

        }

        JumperNoMore();

    }

}

Step 82

You can now move to higher levels with each group of jumpers arriving at their home safely. At each level, of course, you want the game to change (more difficult). There are a number of rules that can be made. At higher levels, all objects are faster, the number of vehicles is increased and some boats are removed. And, at each level, you will be given a new jumper (up to a maximum of five). The rules are developed here:

  • Decrement Interval property of timRiver and timRoad by 10 (minimum value 30).
  • If number of levels are odd (> 1), a jumper is added (maximum number of 5).
  • At Level 2, boatArr[0] is deleted.
  • At Level 3, boatArr [6] removed, vehicleArr[0] and vehicleArr[4] added.
  • At Level 4, boatArr[11] removed, vehicleArr[6] and vehicleArr[10] added.
  • At Level 5, vehicleArr[4] added.

 

Once you reach Level 5, there are 12 vehicles on the road and 9 boats on the river. At this level, the Interval property for the river and road panels is lowered to 40 milliseconds. At each level, you also reposition the boats and vehicles to all position to avoid overlapping problem.

 

All of the above rules are implemented in GoToNextLevel function:

private void GoToNextLevel()

{

    soundNewLevel.PlaySync();

    level++;

    this .Text = "Jumper - Level " + level.ToString();

    DrawHouse();

 

    // Moves faster

    timRoad.Interval -= 10;

 

    if (timRoad.Interval < 30)

        timRoad.Interval = 30;

 

    timRiver.Interval -= 10;

 

    if (timRiver.Interval < 30)

        timRiver.Interval = 30;

 

    // Increases jumpers on next level (max 5)

    if (level % 2 == 1)

    {

        if (remJumper < 5)

        {

            remJumper++;

            formGraphics.DrawImage(jumperUp,

                new Rectangle( this .Width - remJumper *

                jumperUp.Width - 10, 5, jumperUp.Width,

                jumperUp.Height));

            this .Refresh();

        }

    }

 

    // Reposition boats and cars

    LocateBoat();

    LocateVehicle();

 

    // Erases boats, increases cars

    switch (level)

    {

        case 2:

            boatArr[0].Remove(riverGraphics, new

                SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

            break ;

        case 3:

            boatArr[6].Remove(riverGraphics, new

                SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

            vehicleArr[0].Draw(roadGraphics);

            vehicleArr[4].Draw(roadGraphics);

            break ;

        case 4:

            boatArr[11].Remove(riverGraphics,

                new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

            vehicleArr[6].Draw(roadGraphics);

            vehicleArr[10].Draw(roadGraphics);

            break ;

        default :

            vehicleArr[3].Draw(roadGraphics);

            break ;

    }

}

Step 87

The scoring rules used:

  • Each successful jumping forward is awarded 100 points.
  • Every successful reverse jumping is given 50 points.
  • Each successful jumping left or right is awarded 1 point.
  • Each jumper who makes it to the house is awarded 200 points.
  • Each level completed is awarded 1000 points.

private void FormJumper_KeyDown( object sender, KeyEventArgs e)

{

    if (!timRiver.Enabled)

        return ;

 

    // Removed from current location

    RemoveJumper();

 

    if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Up)

    {

        score += 100;

        onBoat = -1;

        soundJump.Play();

        jumper.Picture = jumperUp;

        jumperLocation++;

 

        if (jumperLocation > 8)

            jumperLocation = 8;

    }

    else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Left)

    {

        score += 1;

        onBoat = -1;

        soundJump.Play();

        jumper.Picture = jumperLeft;

 

        if (jumper.Rectangular.X > 0)

            jumper.Rectangular.X -= 40;

    }

    else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Down)

    {

        score += 50;

        onBoat = -1;

        soundJump.Play();

        jumper.Picture = jumperDown;

        jumperLocation--;

 

        if (jumperLocation < 0)

            jumperLocation = 0;

    }

    else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Right)

    {

        score += 1;

        onBoat = -1;

        soundJump.Play();

        jumper.Picture = jumperRight;

 

        if (jumper.Rectangular.X < 600)

            jumper.Rectangular.X += 40;

    }

 

    // Draws in new location

    DrawJumper();

}

            {

                return ;

    else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

        jumperLocation == 7)

        // Checks whether jumper is on the boat

        if (onBoat == -1)

        {

            for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

            {

                if (boatArr[i].IsVisible)

                {

                    if (DoesCollide(boatArr[i].Rectangular,

                        jumper.Rectangular, 80))

                    {

                        onBoat = i;

                        return ;

                    }

                }

            }

 

            if (onBoat == -1)

            {

                JumperNoMore();

                return ;

            }

        }

    }

 

    else if (jumperLocation == 8)

    {

        // Move to house

        for ( int i = 0; i < 5; i++)

        {

            if (!jumperInHouseArr[i] &&

                DoesCollide(rectHouse[i],

                jumper.Rectangular, 100))

            {

                score += 200;

                jumperInHouseArr[i] = true ;

                houseGraphics.DrawImage(jumperInHouse,

                    rectHouse[i].X + 10, rectHouse[i].Y + 10,

                    jumperInHouse.Width, jumperInHouse.Height);

                pnlHouse.Refresh();

                soundHouse.PlaySync();

                getNewJumper();

 

                 // Check for collision

                for ( int j = 0; j < 5; j++)

                    if (!jumperInHouseArr[j])

                        return ;

using System;

using System.Collections.Generic;

using System.Linq;

using System.Text;

using System.Threading.Tasks;

using System.Drawing;

using System.Data;

 

namespace Jumper

{

    class MovingObj

    {

        public Image Picture;

        public Rectangle Rectangular;

        public int Speed;

        public bool IsVisible = false ;

 

        public void Draw(Graphics g)

        {

            g.DrawImage( this .Picture, this .Rectangular);

            this .IsVisible = true ;

        }

 

        public void Move(Graphics g, Brush bc)

        {

            g.FillRectangle(bc, this .Rectangular);

            this .Rectangular.X += this .Speed;

            g.DrawImage( this .Picture, this .Rectangular);

        }

 

        public void Remove(Graphics g, Brush bc)

        {

            g.FillRectangle(bc, this .Rectangular);

            this .IsVisible = false ;

        }

    }

}

        private void getNewJumper()

        {

            onBoat = -1;

            jumperLocation = 0;

            jumper.Rectangular = new Rectangle(320, 0,

                jumperUp.Width, jumperUp.Height);

            jumper.Picture = jumperUp;

            jumper.Draw(startGraphics);

            pnlStart.Refresh();

        }

 

        private void LocateBoat()

        {

            riverGraphics.Clear(pnlRiver.BackColor);

 

            // Upper row

            boatArr[0].Rectangular = new Rectangle(20, 0, 80, 40);

            boatArr[0].Speed = 5;

            boatArr[1].Rectangular = new Rectangle(140, 0, 120, 40);

            boatArr[1].Speed = 5;

            boatArr[2].Rectangular = new Rectangle(300, 0, 40, 40);

            boatArr[2].Speed = 5;

            boatArr[3].Rectangular = new Rectangle(400, 0, 80, 40);

            boatArr[3].Speed = 5;

            boatArr[4].Rectangular = new Rectangle(540, 0, 80, 40);

            boatArr[4].Speed = 5;

 

            // Middle row

            boatArr[5].Rectangular = new Rectangle(60, 40, 40, 40);

            boatArr[5].Speed = -3;

            boatArr[6].Rectangular = new Rectangle(180, 40, 120, 40);

            boatArr[6].Speed = -3;

            boatArr[7].Rectangular = new Rectangle(360, 40, 80, 40);

            boatArr[7].Speed = -3;

            boatArr[8].Rectangular = new Rectangle(500, 40, 120, 40);

            boatArr[8].Speed = -3;

 

            // Lower row

            boatArr[9].Rectangular = new Rectangle(40, 80, 120, 40);

            boatArr[9].Speed = 2;

            boatArr[10].Rectangular = new Rectangle(280, 80, 80, 40);

            boatArr[10].Speed = 2;

            boatArr[11].Rectangular = new Rectangle(480, 80, 120, 40);

            boatArr[11].Speed = 2;

        }

        private void LocateVehicle()

        {

            roadGraphics.Clear(pnlRoad.BackColor);

 

            // Draws lanes

            roadGraphics.DrawLine(Pens.White, 0, 2, pnlRoad.Width, 2);

            roadGraphics.DrawLine(Pens.White, 0, pnlRoad.Height - 2,

                pnlRoad.Width, pnlRoad.Height - 2);

            roadGraphics.DrawLine(Pens.White, 0, 92, pnlRoad.Width, 92);

            roadGraphics.DrawLine(Pens.Yellow, 0, 47, pnlRoad.Width, 47);

            roadGraphics.DrawLine(Pens.Yellow, 0, 49, pnlRoad.Width, 49);

 

            // Upper lane

            vehicleArr[0].Rectangular = new Rectangle(20, 5, 120, 40);

            vehicleArr[0].Speed = 3;

            vehicleArr[1].Rectangular = new Rectangle(200, 5, 80, 40);

            vehicleArr[1].Speed = 3;

            vehicleArr[2].Rectangular = new Rectangle(380, 5, 40, 40);

            vehicleArr[2].Speed = 3;

            vehicleArr[3].Rectangular = new Rectangle(540, 5, 40, 40);

            vehicleArr[3].Speed = 3;

 

            // Middle lane

            vehicleArr[4].Rectangular = new Rectangle(40, 50, 80, 40);

            vehicleArr[4].Speed = -3;

            vehicleArr[5].Rectangular = new Rectangle(220, 50, 40, 40);

            vehicleArr[5].Speed = -3;

            vehicleArr[6].Rectangular = new Rectangle(360, 50, 80, 40);

            vehicleArr[6].Speed = -3;

            vehicleArr[7].Rectangular = new Rectangle(520, 50, 80, 40);

            vehicleArr[7].Speed = -3;

 

            // Lower lane

            vehicleArr[8].Rectangular = new Rectangle(60, 95, 40, 40);

            vehicleArr[8].Speed = -2;

            vehicleArr[9].Rectangular = new Rectangle(180, 95, 120, 40);

            vehicleArr[9].Speed = -2;

            vehicleArr[10].Rectangular = new Rectangle(380, 95, 40, 40);

            vehicleArr[10].Speed = -2;

            vehicleArr[11].Rectangular = new Rectangle(520, 95, 80, 40);

            vehicleArr[11].Speed = -2;

        }

 

        private void btnStartPause_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            if (btnStartPause.Text == "Start Game" )

            {

                btnStartPause.Text = "Pause Game" ;

                btnExitStop.Text = "Stop Game" ;

                LocateVehicle();

 

                for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfVehicles; i++)

                    vehicleArr[i].Draw(roadGraphics);

 

                // Removes cars for Level 1

                vehicleArr[0].Remove(roadGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

                vehicleArr[3].Remove(roadGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

                vehicleArr[4].Remove(roadGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

                vehicleArr[6].Remove(roadGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

                vehicleArr[10].Remove(roadGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

 

                pnlRoad.Refresh();

 

                LocateBoat();

                for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

                    boatArr[i].Draw(riverGraphics);

                pnlRiver.Refresh();

 

                score = 0;

                lblScore.Text = "0" ;

 

                level = 1;

                this .Text = "Jumper - Level 1" ;

                remJumper = 4;

                for ( int i = 0; i < remJumper; i++)

                    formGraphics.DrawImage(jumperUp, new Rectangle(

                        this .Width - (i + 1) * jumperUp.Width - 10,

                        5, jumperUp.Width, jumperUp.Height));

                this .Refresh();

 

                DrawHouse();

                getNewJumper();

 

                // Reset Interval

                timRoad.Interval = 80;

                timRiver.Interval = 80;

 

                timRoad.Enabled = true ;

                timRiver.Enabled = true ;

                timTiger.Enabled = true ;

                timStatus.Enabled = true ;

            }

            else if (btnStartPause.Text == "Pause Game" )

            {

                btnStartPause.Text = "Start Again" ;

                btnExitStop.Enabled = false ;

                timRoad.Enabled = false ;

                timRiver.Enabled = false ;

                timTiger.Enabled = false ;

                timStatus.Enabled = false ;

            }

            else if (btnStartPause.Text == "Start Again" )

            {

                btnStartPause.Text = "Pause Game" ;

                btnExitStop.Enabled = true ;

                timRoad.Enabled = true ;

                timRiver.Enabled = true ;

                timTiger.Enabled = true ;

                timStatus.Enabled = true ;

            }

 

            pnlStart.Focus();

        }

 

        private void btnExitStop_Click( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            if (btnExitStop.Text == "Stop Game" )

            {

                soundGameOver.PlaySync();

                btnExitStop.Text = "Exit" ;

                btnStartPause.Text = "Start Game" ;

 

                if (tiger.IsVisible)

                {

                    tiger.Remove(tigerGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlTiger.BackColor));

                    pnlTiger.Refresh();

                }

 

                if (jumper.IsVisible)

                    RemoveJumper();

 

                timRoad.Enabled = false ;

                timRiver.Enabled = false ;

                timTiger.Enabled = false ;

                timStatus.Enabled = false ;

                UpdateScore();

            }

            else

            {

                this .Close();

            }

        }

 

        private void timRoad_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfVehicles; i++)

            {

                if (vehicleArr[i].IsVisible)

                {

                    vehicleArr[i].Move(roadGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

 

                    if ((vehicleArr[i].Rectangular.X > pnlRoad.Width &&

                        vehicleArr[i].Speed > 0))

                        vehicleArr[i].Rectangular.X = -120;

 

                    if ((vehicleArr[i].Rectangular.X <

                         -vehicleArr[i]. Picture.Width && vehicleArr[i].Speed < 0))

                        vehicleArr[i].Rectangular.X = pnlRoad.Width +

                            (120 - vehicleArr[i].Picture.Width);

                }

            }

            pnlRoad.Refresh();

        }

 

        private void timRiver_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

            {

                if (boatArr[i].IsVisible)

                {

                    boatArr[i].Move(riverGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

 

                    if (onBoat == i)

                    {

                        jumper.Rectangular.X += boatArr[i].Speed;

 

                        if (jumper.Rectangular.X < 0 || jumper.Rectangular.X >

                            640 - jumper.Rectangular.Width)

                        {

                            JumperNoMore();

                            return ;

                        }

 

                        jumper.Draw(riverGraphics);

                    }

 

                    if ((boatArr[i].Rectangular.X > pnlRiver.Width &&

                          boatArr[i].Speed > 0))

                        boatArr[i].Rectangular.X = -120;

 

                    if ((boatArr[i].Rectangular.X < -boatArr[i].Picture.Width &&

                            boatArr[i].Speed < 0))

                        boatArr[i].Rectangular.X = pnlRiver.Width + (

                            120 - boatArr[i].Picture.Width);

                }

            }

            pnlRiver.Refresh();

        }

 

        private void timTiger_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            if (!tiger.IsVisible)

            {

                if (myRand.Next(49) == 0)

                {

                    tiger.Rectangular.X = -tiger1.Width;

                    tiger.Speed = 5;

                    tiger.Picture = tiger1;

                    tigerImage = 1;

                    tiger.Draw(tigerGraphics);

                }

            }

            else

            {

                tiger.Move(tigerGraphics, new SolidBrush(pnlTiger.BackColor));

                if (tigerImage == 1)

                {

                    tigerImage = 2;

                    tiger.Picture = tiger2;

                }

                else

                {

                    tigerImage = 1;

                    tiger.Picture = tiger1;

                }

 

                if (tiger.Rectangular.X > pnlTiger.Width)

                    tiger.Remove(tigerGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlTiger.BackColor));

                pnlTiger.Refresh();

            }

        }

 

        private void FormJumper_KeyDown( object sender, KeyEventArgs e)

        {

            if (!timRiver.Enabled)

                return ;

 

            // Removed from current location

            RemoveJumper();

 

            if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Up)

            {

                score += 100;

                onBoat = -1;

                soundJump.Play();

                jumper.Picture = jumperUp;

                jumperLocation++;

 

                if (jumperLocation > 8)

                    jumperLocation = 8;

            }

            else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Left)

            {

                score += 1;

                onBoat = -1;

                soundJump.Play();

                jumper.Picture = jumperLeft;

 

                if (jumper.Rectangular.X > 0)

                    jumper.Rectangular.X -= 40;

            }

            else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Down)

            {

                score += 50;

                onBoat = -1;

                soundJump.Play();

                jumper.Picture = jumperDown;

                jumperLocation--;

 

                if (jumperLocation < 0)

                    jumperLocation = 0;

            }

            else if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Right)

            {

                score += 1;

                onBoat = -1;

                soundJump.Play();

                jumper.Picture = jumperRight;

 

                if (jumper.Rectangular.X < 600)

                    jumper.Rectangular.X += 40;

            }

 

            // Draws in new location

            DrawJumper();

        }

 

        public void RemoveJumper()

        {

            if (jumperLocation == 0)

            {

                jumper.Remove(startGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlStart.BackColor));

                pnlStart.Refresh();

            }

            else if (jumperLocation == 1 || jumperLocation == 2 ||

                  jumperLocation == 3)

            {

                jumper.Remove(roadGraphics, new SolidBrush(pnlRoad.BackColor));

                pnlRoad.Refresh();

            }

            else if (jumperLocation == 4)

            {

                jumper.Remove(tigerGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlTiger.BackColor));

                pnlTiger.Refresh();

            }

            else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

                jumperLocation == 7)

            {

                jumper.Remove(riverGraphics,

                    new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

                pnlRiver.Refresh();

            }

        }

 

        public void DrawJumper()

        {

            if (jumperLocation == 0)

            {

                jumper.Rectangular.Y = 0;

                jumper.Draw(startGraphics);

                pnlStart.Refresh();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 1 || jumperLocation == 2 ||

                jumperLocation == 3)

            {

                jumper.Rectangular.Y = 140 - 45 * jumperLocation;

                jumper.Draw(roadGraphics);

                pnlRoad.Refresh();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 4)

            {

                jumper.Rectangular.Y = 0;

                jumper.Draw(tigerGraphics);

                pnlTiger.Refresh();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

                jumperLocation == 7)

            {

                jumper.Rectangular.Y = 120 - 40 * (jumperLocation - 4);

                jumper.Draw(riverGraphics);

                pnlRiver.Refresh();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 8)

            {

                jumper.Rectangular.Y = 40;

                jumper.Draw(houseGraphics);

                pnlHouse.Refresh();

 

            }

        }

 

        private bool DoesCollide(Rectangle rect1, Rectangle rect2, double percentage)

        {

            Rectangle collision;

            collision = Rectangle.Intersect(rect1, rect2);

 

            if (collision.Width * collision.Height >= percentage *

                  rect2.Width * rect2.Height / 100)

                return ( true );

            else

                return ( false );

        }

 

        private void timStatus_Tick( object sender, EventArgs e)

        {

            UpdateScore();

 

            // Check collision

            if (jumperLocation == 1 || jumperLocation == 2 || jumperLocation == 3)

            {

                // Vehicles

                for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfVehicles; i++)

                {

                    if (vehicleArr[i].IsVisible)

                    {

                        if (DoesCollide(vehicleArr[i].Rectangular,

                              jumper.Rectangular, 10))

                        {

                            JumperNoMore();

                            return ;

                        }

                    }

                }

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 4)

            {

                // tiger

                if (tiger.IsVisible)

                {

                    if (DoesCollide(tiger.Rectangular, jumper.Rectangular, 1))

                    {

                        JumperNoMore();

                        return ;

                    }

                }

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

                 jumperLocation == 7)

            {

                // Checks whether jumper is on the boat

                if (onBoat == -1)

                {

                    for ( int i = 0; i < numberOfBoats; i++)

                    {

                        if (boatArr[i].IsVisible)

                        {

                            if (DoesCollide(boatArr[i].Rectangular,

                                 jumper.Rectangular, 80))

                            {

                                onBoat = i;

                                return ;

                            }

                        }

                    }

 

                    if (onBoat == -1)

                    {

                        JumperNoMore();

                        return ;

                    }

                }

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 8)

            {

                // Move to house

                for ( int i = 0; i < 5; i++)

                {

                    if (!jumperInHouseArr[i] && DoesCollide(rectHouse[i],

                          jumper.Rectangular, 100))

                    {

                        score += 200;

                        jumperInHouseArr[i] = true ;

                        houseGraphics.DrawImage(jumperInHouse, rectHouse[i].X + 10 ,

                            rectHouse[i].Y + 10, jumperInHouse.Width,

                            jumperInHouse.Height);

                        pnlHouse.Refresh();

                        soundHouse.PlaySync();

                        getNewJumper();

 

                        // Check for collision

                        for ( int j = 0; j < 5; j++)

                            if (!jumperInHouseArr[j])

                                return ;

 

                        score += 200;

                        GoToNextLevel();

                        return ;

                    }

                }

                JumperNoMore();

            }

        }

 

        private void UpdateScore()

        {

            // Updates score

            lblScore.Text = score.ToString();

            lblScore.Refresh();

 

            if (score > highestScore)

            {

                highestScore = score;

                lblHighestScore.Text = highestScore.ToString();

            }

        }

 

        private void JumperNoMore()

        {

            if (jumperLocation == 1 || jumperLocation == 2 || jumperLocation == 3)

            {

                soundCollide.Play();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 4)

            {

                soundTiger.Play();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 5 || jumperLocation == 6 ||

                jumperLocation == 7)

            {

                soundDrowned.Play();

            }

 

            else if (jumperLocation == 8)

            {

                soundDrowned.Play();

            }

 

            RemoveJumper();

 

            formGraphics.FillRectangle( new SolidBrush( this .BackColor),

                new Rectangle( this .Width - remJumper * jumperUp.Width - 10,

                5, jumperUp.Width, jumperUp.Height));

            remJumper--;

            this .Refresh();

 

            if (remJumper >= 0)

                getNewJumper();

            else

                btnExitStop.PerformClick();

        }

 

        private void DrawHouse()

        {

            houseGraphics.FillRectangle(brushHouse, 0, 0,

                pnlHouse.Width, pnlHouse.Height);

            rectHouse[0] = new Rectangle(70, 20, 60, 60);

            rectHouse[1] = new Rectangle(180, 20, 60, 60);

            rectHouse[2] = new Rectangle(290, 20, 60, 60);

            rectHouse[3] = new Rectangle(400, 20, 60, 60);

            rectHouse[4] = new Rectangle(510, 20, 60, 60);

 

            for ( int i = 0; i < 5; i++)

            {

                houseGraphics.FillRectangle(Brushes.Blue, rectHouse[i]);

                jumperInHouseArr[i] = false ;

            }

            pnlHouse.Refresh();

        }

 

        private void GoToNextLevel()

        {

            soundNewLevel.PlaySync();

            level++;

            this .Text = "Jumper - Level " + level.ToString();

            DrawHouse();

 

            // Moves faster

            timRoad.Interval -= 10;

 

            if (timRoad.Interval < 30)

                timRoad.Interval = 30;

 

            timRiver.Interval -= 10;

 

            if (timRiver.Interval < 30)

                timRiver.Interval = 30;

 

            // Increases jumpers on next level (max 5)

            if (level % 2 == 1)

            {

                if (remJumper < 5)

                {

                    remJumper++;

                    formGraphics.DrawImage(jumperUp,

                        new Rectangle( this . Width - remJumper * jumperUp.Width - 10,

                        5, jumperUp.Width, jumperUp.Height));

                    this .Refresh();

                }

            }

 

            // Reposition boats and cars

            LocateBoat();

            LocateVehicle();

 

            // Erases boats, increases cars

            switch (level)

            {

                case 2:

                    boatArr[0].Remove(riverGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

                    break ;

                case 3:

                    boatArr[6].Remove(riverGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

                    vehicleArr[0].Draw(roadGraphics);

                    vehicleArr[4].Draw(roadGraphics);

                    break ;

                case 4:

                    boatArr[11].Remove(riverGraphics,

                        new SolidBrush(pnlRiver.BackColor));

                    vehicleArr[6].Draw(roadGraphics);

                    vehicleArr[10].Draw(roadGraphics);

                    break ;

                default :

                    vehicleArr[3].Draw(roadGraphics);

                    break ;

            }

        }

 

    }

}
